# Steven W. Carter — campaign walkthrough

- Original source: [Steven W. Carter — campaign walkthrough](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc/562021-robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/faqs/23124)
- Author / publication: Steven W. Carter (swcarter) / GameFAQs
- Language / date: English; updated 2003-05-03
- Access: Page text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The substantial campaign reference supplied by the user. It covers the six principal heroes, three generic Merry Men archetypes, gameplay advice, Sherwood camp, ambushes, defensive missions, and sixteen numbered campaign missions.

Its organization makes it useful for looking up a particular rescue, infiltration, or final assault. The campaign runs from Finding Godwin and Rescuing Stuteley through Last Challenge; forest activity and the first ambush have separate sections. Character information and camp notes accompany the routes rather than requiring readers to infer abilities from individual missions.

Use this as a period player's account, not an engine specification. Its sixteen-entry campaign list differs from the seventeen-main-mission count in the later scoring guide, which includes conditional Free Lincoln. Consult the original for step-by-step routes and its Sherwood map.

**Topics:** campaign progression, character abilities, training, supplies, ambushes, castle defense.
